description: This file defines a Flutter widget called HomeFragment that displays a map-based ride-sharing UI. It manages user location, rider approach simulation, routes, markers, and UI overlays for destination input and ride status. It interacts with several external packages such as google_maps_flutter, geolocator, provider, and geocoding.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages the map UI, location, routes, and ride workflow.

classes.name: _HomeFragmentState
classes.description: The state class that contains all the logic for location, map interactions, ride simulation, and UI overlays.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes widget state and gets current location.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up timers, controllers, and other resources.

methods.name: _getCurrentLocation
methods.description: Fetches the user's current location and initializes map markers.

methods.name: _reverseGeocode
methods.description: Converts latitude and longitude to a human-readable address.

methods.name: _initializeMarkers
methods.description: Adds initial mock rider markers at locations near the user's position.

methods.name: _buildGoogleMap
methods.description: Builds the GoogleMap widget with appropriate settings and error handling.

methods.name: _buildMapFallback
methods.description: Displays a placeholder UI when Google Maps fails to load.

methods.name: _onCameraIdle
methods.description: Triggered when the map camera stops moving; updates location and address.

methods.name: _buildBottomPanel
methods.description: Builds the bottom UI with location cards and ride button.

methods.name: _buildRideStatusCard
methods.description: Builds a UI card showing ride status during an active ride.

methods.name: _openLocationSearch
methods.description: Opens the destination search sheet.

methods.name: _onDestinationSelected
methods.description: Handles user selecting a destination, updating markers and routes.

methods.name: _drawRoutePolyline
methods.description: Draws a polyline route between origin and destination points.

methods.name: _generateRoutePoints
methods.description: Generates intermediate points to form a curved route line.

methods.name: _fitMapToRoute
methods.description: Adjusts camera to fit both start and end points.

methods.name: _showRideBottomSheet
methods.description: Displays the bottom sheet for ride confirmation.

methods.name: _startRiderApproach
methods.description: Simulates rider approaching by moving the rider marker.

methods.name: _onRiderArrived
methods.description: Handles rider arriving, shows dialog to start journey.

methods.name: _startJourney
methods.description: Simulates the journey progressing towards the destination.

methods.name: _onJourneyComplete
methods.description: Handles journey completion, resets state, and navigates to celebration screen.
